# Can we stabilize the obs_groups KeyError by downgrading Isaac Lab 2.2.1 to 2.2.0 while retaining Isaac Sim 5.0?

> **Current answer:** A user successfully downgraded from Isaac Lab 2.2.1 to 2.2.0 and confirmed it on a 5070 Ti, but the original questioner still encountered a KeyError when using the same major version. Another user reported that Lab 2.2.1 and Isaac Sim 5.0 are now operational. Therefore, this combination is a candidate, and it must be verified alongside rsl-rl-lib, installation methods, project submission, and actual tasks.

- Tracking-Flat-G1-v0 throws KeyError: obs_groups during OnPolicyRunner initialization; should we switch to Isaac Lab/Sim or update rsl-rl?
